detail.permitInfo: Continuing past Enron ramp requires a permit from the Uintah and Ouray tribe. As of 2024, permits are not available.
detail.description:
This long, not very steep stretch has at least two dams. Paddlers would probably choose to put in below one or another dam and paddle to the next flatwater.

The BLM publishes [a brochure with maps](https://www.blm.gov/sites/blm.gov/files/documents/files/white%20river%20for%20web.pdf) for this river.
